notes.title: Update v1.2.7 - Controller Support!
notes.content: Hi Everyone, Sorry for the radio silence but the "real" job got in the way and this controller support took longer than expected! Here it is anyway, full controller support for Wizard Shrimp. I would still personally recommend a mouse and keyboard as aiming whilst moving and hitting all the other buttons for jump/blink/grapple etc can get overwhelming! However, if you're a _controller nerd_ who doesn't want to use a m+kb then you're in luck! As always, email me with any bugs: wizardshrimpgames@gmail.com Other changes in this patch: - Bug fix: fairy spec not unlocking when you have over 200 enemies killed by wisps - Removed the extra scene in between building your path and the first encounter, it now just takes you to the first encounter. You can still view this scene if you want to look at the full path in between encounters. - Disabled the "spawn more enemies" button when in credits - Moved the "spawn more enemies" button out of the way - Updated Treasure Chest art - Changed the way pop ups display so it's more obvious when you have multiple Controller Image Attribution: 8 Bit Controller Vectors by Vecteezy

notes.content:

Some exciting stuff coming next now that bug is out the way.

Bugs and feedback to wizardshrimpgames@gmail.com

kissies x

notes.title: Patch v1.2.0.6
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
I am now back from my holiday and so will resume patching my silly little game and working on some exciting new stuff for you lot!

This one is mainly some hot fixes for bugs that surfaced while I was away.
Patch notes:

- Extra Attack Damage % Krill points were actually reducing damage dealt, this is now fixed.
- Butt Spell no longer counts towards every 10th spell is a wide spell krill point.
- Changed achievement and fairy shrimp unlock from 1000 enemies killed by wisps to 200 enemies killed by wisps which hopefully aligns a bit better with the other specialization unlocks.
- Fixed not getting krill points when beating the game.
- Enemies killed by black holes will no longer count towards the next black hole.
- When getting a free item there is a Skip Item button on the left, and then once you have picked up the item, the continue button displays over to the right. Should help people accidentally skipping the item.
- Updated loading screen with a new sprite and also sped it up so that loading between scenes is faster.
- Stopped upgrades menu spawning before all enemies have been cleared.


Some things that I am going to be working on for future updates:
- Full controller support
- Steam deck support
- Mac support
- Endless Mode 
- More Upgrades
- More Items
- More Krill Tree Nodes
- More Cauldron Levels
- Updating some of the art (any suggestions on what needs updating the most (i.e. what is the worst art in the game) please let me know)

You will have to bare with me on some of these as it's still only me working on this game and I have many other projects going on as well as a full time job!
Thanks for playing and as always any feedback and bugs to my email:
wizardshrimpgames@gmail.com

Happy Shrimping!
Wizard Shrimp Games

notes.title: Patch v1.2.0.3
notes.content:
Hey everyone I'm so sorry about the game breaking bug that some of you experienced! I hope it didn't ruin your experience too much.

The bug was happening on the final boss fight, when the player had a combination of slowing and stunning spells the purple mushroom wizard was getting stunned/slowed to oblivion and eventually would stop taking damage and cause the player to be stuck! How annoying, especially on the final boss fight! 
This is unfortunately the nature of making a game like this, no matter how much testing I did there's always going to be one random combination of upgrades that I haven't tested.

This is hopefully fixed now, a few hours before I have to go on holiday! 

I have also slightly nerfed the health of the gargoyle boss, and both mushroom bosses as I felt the fights went on a bit too long.

I also fixed other projectiles that the shrimp fires getting affected by the wide spell krill tree skill.

I really am going away for a week now so no updates for a while! 
Fingers crossed everyone for no more game breaking bugs...

feedback and bugs to: wizardshrimpgames@gmail.com

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE v1.2 - The Krill Tree
notes.content:
Okay, okay, I hear you! You all wanted roguelite elements (the ability to level up in between runs) and I've delivered! 
Introducing, The Krill Tree!
If you play the game on the hardest difficulty that you have unlocked, you will gain Krill points to spend in the Krill Tree. You also gain access to three new specializations which you can unlock via achievements.

Enjoy! and as always, any bugs or feedback please email me wizardshrimpgames@gmail.com

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE v1.1 - The Cauldron
notes.content:
Here it is! My first huge update to Wizard Shrimp, v1.1. Complete with a new gamemode!

[b]The Cauldron Mode[/b]
The Cauldron mode will be unlocked when you defeat the game on hard mode (if you have already got the achievement for this you should have it unlocked already).
If you have previously played the hard mode and found it too difficult don't be discouraged, there has been some balancing changes and hard mode is now quite a bit easier 😎
Each level of the Cauldron will add a new modifier to the base game, making it harder! At level 5 for example, all the bosses you meet will have additional attacks to learn!
Jump in and see how far you can push it!

In addition to the new mode I have added new Upgrades, Items, and patched a few other things:

[b]New Upgrades[/b]
[list]
[*] Tempura Jacket
[*] Trident
[*] Recovery
[*] Bouncy Balls
[/list]

[b]New Items[/b]
[list]
[*] Axe
[*] Pickaxe
[*] Hammer
[/list]

[b]Minor Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added an "Are you sure?" when navigating to main menu from pause menu
[*] Fixed Ent bugging out and not attacking when slowed/stunned
[*] Buffed base attack speed again from 5 to 7% each level
[*] Blood sacrifice scales the coins given with the level (25, 50, 100)
[*] Changed campfire coin amount in stage 4 to 2000 instead of 2500
[*] Reduced damage Ent deals
[*] Reduced health of crystal
[*] Reduced damage of Green Mushroom Boss attacks
[*] Reduce damage taken from most enemies
[/list]

- Homing spells no longer home in on the Ent while the Ent is summoning frogs.
- Ent hit collider for his smash attack slightly more forgiving.
- Enemy spawn rate changes to level 2 and 3 (spawn more frequently).

Joshua Bailey
